site.title: Spatial Omics Radar
site.subtitle: New technologies, tools, AI models and benchmarks across spatial omics

entries.name: NNclinSSOAP
entries.title: GxP-Ready Single-Cell RNA-seq and Spatial Transcriptomics End-to-End Pipeline for Clinical Research
entries.one_liner: Modular, regulatory-compliant pipeline converting scRNA-seq and Xenium spatial data into annotated tissue maps.

entries.name: AESTETIK
entries.title: Representation learning for multi-modal spatially resolved transcriptomics data
entries.one_liner: Convolutional model jointly integrating spatial, transcriptomic and morphology data to learn spot representations.

entries.name: CONCISE
entries.title: Spatial co-expression and cell-cell communication inference from spatially resolved transcriptomics with CONCISE
entries.one_liner: Statistical method jointly modeling spatial autocorrelation and count variation for robust cell-cell communication inference.

entries.name: spammR
entries.title: spammR: an R package designed for analysis and integration of spatial multi-omic measurements
entries.one_liner: R package for end-to-end analysis and integration of mass-spectrometry-based spatial multi-omics data.

entries.name: AdPrST
entries.title: AdPrST:An Adversarial Graph Deep Learning Pre-clustering Framework for Deciphering Spatiotemporal Structures in Spatially Resolved Transcriptomics
entries.one_liner: Adversarial graph pre-clustering framework inferring spatial domains and spatiotemporal trajectories in tissue.
entries.venue: IEEE transactions on computational biology and bioinformatics

entries.name: HESTIA
entries.title: HESTIA: Scalable Multimodal Integration of Histology and High-Resolution Spatial Transcriptomics for Robust Spatial Domain Identification
entries.one_liner: Memory-efficient algorithm integrating histology and high-resolution spatial transcriptomics to identify spatial domains at scale.

entries.name: DEGAS (spatial smoothing)
entries.title: Identification of high-risk cells in single-cell spatially resolved transcriptomics data using Diagnostic Evidence GAuge of Single-cells with spatial smoothing
entries.one_liner: Domain-adaptation model transferring disease attributes to single cells, extended with spatial smoothing for spatial platforms.

entries.name: GCAST
entries.title: Identifying batch-integrated domains from spatial transcriptomics via graph autoencoder with contrastive learning based on cross-modality and data augmentation
entries.one_liner: Graph contrastive autoencoder integrating histology and expression to identify batch-corrected spatial domains.

entries.name: TENGU
entries.title: A transcriptomic-driven segmentation and cell simulation framework for high-resolution spatial transcriptomics and cell-cell communication
entries.one_liner: Transcript-first segmentation and cell-simulation pipeline improving cell boundaries and cell-cell communication analysis in Visium HD data.

entries.name: TOAST
entries.title: Topography-aware optimal transport for alignment of spatial omics data
entries.one_liner: Optimal-transport framework aligning spatial tissue slices and integrating single-cell with spatial data.

entries.name: Castl
entries.title: Castl: robust identification of spatially variable genes in spatial transcriptomics via an ensemble-based framework
entries.one_liner: Ensemble framework aggregating multiple algorithms to robustly identify spatially variable genes.

entries.name: mosna
entries.title: mosna Reveals Different Types of Cellular Interactions Predictive of Response to Immunotherapies and Survival in Cancer
entries.one_liner: Python package analyzing cell interactions and tissue niches across spatial omics platforms, integrating clinical data.

entries.name: ovrlpy
entries.title: Identifying 3D signal overlaps in spatial transcriptomics data with ovrlpy
entries.one_liner: Identifies overlapping cells, tissue folds and segmentation errors by analyzing 3D transcript localization in imaging-based ST.

entries.name: stDyer-image
entries.title: stDyer-image improves clustering analysis of spatially resolved transcriptomics and proteomics with morphological images
entries.one_liner: End-to-end deep learning framework that clusters spatial transcriptomics/proteomics data using morphology image features directly.

entries.name: NNclinSSOAP
entries.title: GxP Single-cell RNA-seq and Spatial Transcriptomics end-to-end pipeline for clinical research
entries.one_liner: Modular, GxP-ready pipeline transforming scRNA-seq and Xenium spatial data into annotated, reproducible tissue maps for clinical use.

entries.name: MAGPIE
entries.title: Spatially resolved integrative analysis of transcriptomic and metabolomic changes in tissue injury studies
entries.one_liner: Modular framework co-registering spatial transcriptomics, mass-spec metabolomics and morphology from matched or consecutive tissue sections.

entries.name: Xenium Prime 5K
entries.one_liner: Expanded in situ panel profiling ~5,000 genes at subcellular resolution.
